name: Safety Core Control Registry
scope: Executable safety controls owned by Safety Core Meta OS.

entities.name: Validation Control
entities.responsibility: Reject malformed, incomplete, ambiguous, or unsupported safety records.

entities.name: Integrity Control
entities.responsibility: Create and verify SHA-256 evidence for bounded files and records.

entities.name: Risk Control
entities.responsibility: Classify declared likelihood and impact deterministically.

entities.name: Monitoring Control
entities.responsibility: Evaluate caller-supplied observations against explicit thresholds.

entities.name: Audit Control
entities.responsibility: Verify and query append-oriented safety evidence without mutation.

entities.name: Backup Control
entities.responsibility: Create a verified archive from bounded regular files.

entities.name: Recovery Control
entities.responsibility: Recover verified archives without traversal, symlinks, or overwrite.

entities.name: Execution Safety Control
entities.responsibility: Return fail-closed allow, deny, or review decisions without executing actions.

entities.name: Incident Management Control
entities.responsibility: Enforce incident states, transitions, containment, and recovery evidence.
